affirm: Buy now, pay later lender (San Francisco). Ribbit's first documented round is Affirm's April 2019 Series F: its AF-F Ribbit Opportunity III vehicle (Form D, 2019Q2) and Ribbit Capital III both signed the amended investors' rights agreement filed with the S-1 (exhibit 4.2, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1820953/000110465920126927/tm2026663d5_ex4-2.htm). Ribbit Capital III is a 2015 fund, so any earlier fund cheque falls in 2015 or later, when Affirm was past its Series A; the entry is Growth either way. Public since January 2021 (NASDAQ: AFRM); market cap $22.68B on 2026-09-28 (StockAnalysis).
figure: Blockchain-based lender (HELOCs on the Provenance chain). Principal office 100 West Liberty Street, Reno, Nevada (the 2025 S-1/A, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2064124/000162828025041731/figuretechnologysolutionsi.htm). Ribbit co-led, with DST, the company's first institutional round of May 2018, about $50M (FinTech Global; the Form D of 2018-05-24 sold $51.1M). The next round was the named $65M Series B of February 2019 (the company's release, Ribbit participating), and Wikipedia names a 2018 Series A, so the 2018 round is the Series A: the band's Growth reads the round size, not the round, and is disputed. Ribbit Capital IV held 10.9% before the IPO. Public on NASDAQ (FIGR) since September 2025; market cap $6.58B on 2026-09-28 (StockAnalysis).
funding-circle: Small-business lending marketplace (London). The known country US is a wrong join (the American subsidiary); Funding Circle is British, as the Accel and USV sibling rows also record. Ribbit joined the $37M round of October 2013 led by Accel with USV and Index (Wikipedia), which AltAssets names the Series C (https://www.altassets.net/private-equity-news/by-news-type/deal-news/accel-leads-37m-series-c-round-for-non-banking-loan-business-funding-circle.html); USV and Index had funded the A and B, so Ribbit's entry is Growth. Its FC and FC-GEM vehicles followed. Listed on the London Stock Exchange since September 2018 (FCH); market cap $701M on 2026-09-28 (StockAnalysis; GBP 528.8M @ ECB 2026-09-28 (GBP/EUR 0.85785, EUR/USD 1.1378) = $701.4M).
robinhood: Commission-free brokerage (Menlo Park since 2018, Wikipedia). Ribbit came in as a new investor in the $13M Series A of September 2014 led by returning investor Index Ventures (Wikipedia), and followed through its deal vehicles in the Series C (2017), D (2018) and E (2019) and the February 2021 notes (RH, RH-D, RH-E, RH-N Form Ds). Public since July 2021; market cap $104.71B on 2026-09-28 (StockAnalysis).
